groups.sentence: Students clearly identify which parts of their work were generated by AI.
Students show AI-generated text in a different font color, highlight or red marking.
Students state AI use in code comments, including which tool was used, and mark AI-generated code portions.
Example code comments or notes credit an AI tool for the work.
Everyone documents AI-derived code sections, including who reviewed them.
Students put AI-generated text in quotation marks with citation and never include it verbatim without them.
Students include the prompt and significant parts of the AI response.
Students disclose AI use in data analysis methods and figure captions.
Students may acknowledge AI use through in-text citations, quotations, references or comments.
